modarea.summary: Gives mods room inside the Syntakt to keep their code.

delay-control-runtime.summary: Shared DelayCtrl code that the features need. It is added for you.

delay-control-core.summary: Freeze and beat repeat on the FX track, TRIG 13-16 on MOD B.

delay-control-dj.summary: DJ filter replaces LP-Notch in the FX filter list.

delay-control-drive.summary: Adds a rectifier to FX Drive 5 to 11, for digital tracks only.

delay-control-syn.summary: Shortcuts on the FX SYN page: reverb, send, filter and Drive.
